content: As they walk across the burrough, Sutri begins to explain the history of the burrough. "One of the things I like so much about this place is how many different groups have been here so long. You've got the fey, the chinn natives, the jackalope natives, the wudgie natives... and then you've got the human natives, like me." They do an exaggerated flourish. "Though of course i'm not fully human anymore." They laugh and gesture to their large ears.
"It's very becoming though," Irynx shifts back into an owlfolk and walks up to the group.
"But we've all been here for a long time. Not me personally, but i digress..."
'Different groups, but all the same at heart, people who just want to live their lives...'
Sutri blushes mildly. "Why thank you. I'm a big fan of feathers myself."
"Well, I'm not really fully human either." Roy says and shifts.
"I've always admired the sense of family here" bo smiles. "Don' matter where ya come from, it's like a big family"
Sabrine croaks in agreement.
"Oh I *thought* you were a panther!" Sutri exclaims as Roy shifts. "Glad to see I was right. I can tell about people who are animal folk tanks to the bleeds, but not for other reasons."
"You didn't change like Ed, huh, Roy?"

"Yeah, I've heard people have been changing here, but I've always been like this. Back in my home town, many people are like this, but even when there are differences, one thing that unites us is the swarm."

"Anyways, now we get to the council. It wasn't until quite recently that there was really a need for one, as people mostly used to just govern ourselves. But eventually we got big enough and things around us did too, to the point where we kind of needed a group of people to make sure the things that had to get done were getting done well." They smile. "Now, which of the council members are you all familiar with?"
"The twins, they're on the council right? And Ferrah. And you!"
'I met all of you during the gamebooth restoration, I believe.'
"Yeah, the same as Irynx."
Bo rubs his arms as he senses his looming shadow. Its clear that bo is uneasy.
They nod. "Sabrine, can you name the ones they're missing?" they have a slight teacher-like vibe to them, which you guess is a carry-over from the fact that they work with kids all day.
'There's Pirrame, a sprite with a toothpick-sized sword, who I'd want to take lessons from if I had any skill with a sword because seriously, her skill is impressive.'
'Uncle Paddy, a Kimmelian, he's around a lot so I'm surprised none of you have met him.'
'And Demetrius, a ki-rin - I hope I pronounced that right.'
